added: Place: a shallow splash court with white stone channels and glass windbreaks at midday.
Activity: she guides one little brass float through branching channels before it enters the wrong basin.
Outfit: an opaque garnet swim playsuit made from curved neoprene panels, a scalloped diagonal yoke with one sleeve sewn to it, and fitted mid-thigh swim shorts. Chest and pelvis stay covered.

Situation: she props one knee on the low stone rim to reach a stalled marker. The bent knee raises a shallow scalloped side tab on her fitted shorts, revealing a crescent of outer thigh above the hem.
Composition: vertical front three-quarter at her seated eye level, with her head and her propped knee inside the frame.
Pose: her left palm braces against the flat rim beside her hip. Her right index finger gently guides the float. A graphite diamond earring echoes her motif.

added: Place: a quiet laundromat with bright cool white light over pale mint tiles and round dryer doors.
Activity: she waits on a folded laundry bag, watching the last slow turn of a mustard blanket through the glass.

Outfit: a close-fitting opaque lilac square-neck knit vest with a ladder of three small oval waist cutouts at one side, bare shoulders, high-waisted cream barrel trousers with pleated knees, and rust loafers.
Composition: a vertical seated portrait framed from head to below her knees, seen from the front at seated eye level. She looks toward the dryer slightly to one side of the camera.
Pose: both feet rest on the tiles. Her left hand lies across her left knee. Her right hand loosely holds a blank brass laundry token above her right knee. A silver diamond earring echoes her motif.
